agent.problem: The card retells the lions withdrawing at sunrise from Psalm 104:22 in "The lions clock out," then tells about people going to work from Psalm 104:23. It cites only Psalm 104:23, so its citation should be Psalm 104:22-23.

rule.text: Cite exactly what the card uses. Every story card cites the verses it tells, from the first verse it uses to the last, no wider and no narrower.
